name: Coast & Country Stays
accommodation: Nine cottages in Beadnell including Church Cottage (sleeps 6), plus others in Seahouses and Bamburgh
suitableFor: Couples, families, groups and dog owners
beachAccess: Beadnell cottages are within walking distance of the beaches
confirmedFeatures: Online booking, pet friendly, some properties with sea views
overview: A local operator with nine holiday cottages in Beadnell village, alongside a handful in Seahouses and Bamburgh. Properties range from small cottages to larger family houses, and dogs are welcomed across the collection. The beaches of Beadnell Bay are within walking distance of the village cottages.
surfTripFit: A choice of dog-friendly cottages in the village, walkable to the bay.
